Senior Frontend Engineer

An overview of this role

As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you'll solve high-scope frontend problems and influence your team's technical and product direction. You'll ship moderately sized features with minimal guidance, improve quality and performance, mentor other engineers, and help establish standards for a high-scale web environment. You'll partner across product, design, backend, and frontend to make sound trade-offs, communicate clearly, and improve how the team delivers software.

This is an opportunity to shape product experiences and frontend architecture for a global platform while helping define how modern frontend teams use agentic artificial intelligence. You'll apply artificial intelligence-assisted engineering workflows thoughtfully and help create trustworthy user experiences that incorporate artificial intelligence responsibly in a remote-first, asynchronous organization.

What you’ll do

  • Design and ship moderately sized frontend features and improvements with minimal guidance, making pragmatic architectural choices.
  • Turn ambiguous customer and product needs into clear technical plans and intuitive, accessible experiences.
  • Advocate for product quality, security, accessibility, performance, maintainability, and operational readiness throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Establish and improve practices for frontend architecture, styling, component design, testing, observability, maintainable code, and thoughtful use of artificial intelligence and agentic tools in production engineering work.
  • Mentor Associate and Intermediate Engineers, share knowledge, remove technical blockers, and improve team delivery practices.
  • Diagnose and prevent frontend performance and reliability issues at scale using observability and production signals, and participate in incident response or on-call responsibilities under your team's ownership model.
  • Design or review independently buildable frontend surfaces and explicit contracts for data, events, authorization, feature flags, error handling, testing, and performance expectations.
  • Collaborate with product, design, backend, quality, security, and other teams to deliver cohesive customer outcomes.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience applying frontend architecture, browser behavior, testing, accessibility, performance, and maintainability practices in a complex product or platform environment.
  • Experience designing or evolving modular frontend boundaries, independently buildable surfaces, component systems, or migration-safe architectures.
  • Experience making pragmatic trade-offs with product and design partners and turning complex requirements into clear user experiences.
  • The ability to lead through technical judgment, collaboration, and clear written communication rather than formal authority.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and improving team practices through code review, design review, documentation, or hands-on collaboration.
  • The ability to work effectively in a remote, asynchronous organization by managing priorities, creating clarity, and communicating decisions in writing.
  • Practical experience integrating artificial intelligence into a feature, workflow, or engineering process, or evaluating its reliability, security, privacy, and appropriate human oversight.
  • Helpful, but not required: experience with Vue, React, Angular, TypeScript, or JavaScript; PostgreSQL, Redis, or object storage; representational state transfer or GraphQL; Kubernetes, Google Kubernetes Engine, Docker, or Google Cloud Platform; Prometheus or Sentry; and Git, GitLab Runner, or GitLab continuous integration and continuous delivery.

About the team

We own core repository capabilities, from Git command-line operations to web-based code exploration. Our roadmap includes feature and platform development, improvements to existing capabilities, maintainability, accessibility, performance, and workflows for teams using AI-assisted development tools.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave 

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Who We Are
Atlan is building the context layer for enterprise AI. Enterprises are pouring money into AI and most of it dies in production because the AI does not understand the business context around the data. That is the problem Atlan solves.

Gartner has named context the defining issue in enterprise AI, and calls context graphs the essential infrastructure for AI agents, naming Atlan one of three vendors already building it. We are also the only vendor named a Leader across all four major Gartner and Forrester evaluations for data catalogs, data governance and metadata management, the foundation the context layer runs on.
Come build the infrastructure that AI runs on.
Atlan is evolving from a world of apps to a world where apps and AI agents work together. The Agent & App Platform team is building the foundational infrastructure that makes this possible.
We’re looking for a Principal Software Engineer to help set the technical direction for the agent registry and gateway platform.
The Team
The Agent & App Platform team builds the foundations that allow Atlan teams, partners, and customers to build, run, distribute, observe, and govern apps and agents reliably at scale.
You’ll work across areas such as:
• 
Agent Registry & Gateways: Systems for registering, discovering, authenticating, governing, and routing agents, tools, and MCP servers.
• 
Agent Platform: Shared capabilities for agent execution, including identity, context, secure execution, sessions, checkpointing, and observability.
• 
App Runtime: Reliable execution infrastructure built on Kubernetes and Temporal.
• 
Distribution & Automation: Packaging, deployment, marketplace experiences, workflows, triggers, templates, and automation capabilities.
What You’ll Do
You’ll own significant technical problems end-to-end and help build the platform primitives powering Atlan’s next generation of apps and agents.
Depending on your strengths and interests, you may:
• 
Design and build platform services for agents, tools, and MCP servers, including registries, gateways, authentication, authorization, routing, policy enforcement, audit logging, and tracing.
• 
Build the primitives that power agent execution and lifecycle — including templates, marketplace experiences, secure sandboxing, tenant-aware context, durable sessions, checkpointing, and observability.
• 
Evolve Atlan’s workflow and runtime infrastructure using Temporal, Kubernetes, and cloud-native technologies, while improving reliability, scalability, performance, and cost.
• 
Design and operate multi-tenant distributed systems for enterprise workloads at significant scale, solving complex problems around isolation, failure recovery, capacity, and noisy neighbours.
• 
Partner with Product and Engineering teams on how apps and agents come together across registration, distribution, and runtime, and contribute to architecture, RFCs, and technical standards.
• 
Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar through strong engineering practices, design reviews, and technical leadership.
What We’re Looking For
• 
14+ years of experience in platform engineering, infrastructure, or backend systems, ideally in a SaaS environment.
• 
Strong experience building platform services, API gateways, service registries, control planes, or similar systems.
• 
Deep expertise in distributed systems and multi-tenant architectures, including event-driven systems, service communication, orchestration, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery.
• 
Strong Kubernetes, containerization, and cloud infrastructure experience across AWS and/or GCP.
• 
Experience designing systems with clear reliability, latency, capacity, and cost requirements, across both 0→1 and mature production environments.
• 
Ability to work autonomously on ambiguous, cross-functional technical problems and communicate complex trade-offs clearly.
It’s a Plus If You Have
• 
Experience with MCP, A2A, agent frameworks, agent runtimes, LLM gateways, or agent observability.
• 
Experience building marketplaces, plugin ecosystems, extension platforms, developer platforms, or workflow/automation systems.
• 
Experience with identity and authorization for non-human actors, secure sandboxing, context propagation, or multi-tenant agent execution.
• 
Experience with Temporal, Terraform, Helm, GitOps, CI/CD, or container registries.
• 
Experience operating enterprise-scale production systems with demanding SLOs, observability, distributed tracing, or cost attribution.
How We Work
We’re building an AI-native engineering organization and use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude and Cursor as part of our everyday workflow.
You’ll thrive here if you take strong ownership, enjoy ambiguous technical problems, communicate clearly, learn quickly, and care about building reusable primitives, reliable systems, and great developer experiences.
The Technology
Go · Python · AWS · GCP · Kubernetes · Karpenter · Temporal · MCP · Terraform · Helm · Prometheus · Grafana · GitOps
You don’t need experience with every technology listed above. We care more about strong engineering fundamentals, distributed-systems expertise, and the ability to learn quickly.

Why Atlan?
Joining Atlan means being part of a global movement to help data teams do their life’s best work. Here’s what you can expect:
• 
Competitive Compensation: We benchmark at the top of the market and keep compensation simple: strong base salary, performance‑based variable pay, and impact‑driven equity (for most roles), so your total rewards grow in step with the value you create over time.
• 
AI Native Culture: Atlan is where AI-native builders come to build the systems the future of work will run on. AI isn’t an add-on, it’s woven into how we build, think, and work every day, empowering every Atlanian to move faster and create a bigger impact.
• 
Health & Wellness: From Day‑1 health, dental, vision, and mental health to flexible health stipends, we design benefits offerings that lead in each country we're in.
• 
Flexible Time Off & Leave Policies: We trust you to own your energy: flexible time off and modern leave so you can unplug properly, support yourself and your loved ones, and come back ready to drive an impact.
• 
Accelerated Growth & Learning: Develop at an uncommon velocity through cutting-edge tech, complex implementations, and an experienced team that values mastery.
• 
Global, Remote-First, High-Trust: Work from anywhere with a diverse team across 15+ countries, in a trust-first, async environment that gives you true flexibility and ownership over how you work.

More About Us
Atlan is building the shared context layer that enterprises need so AI can operate on trusted, governed context. The conversation has moved from data leaders asking: “Can we trust the data in our stack?” to businesses asking: “Can we trust AI inside the business?”
We are the missing infrastructure for businesses becoming AI-forward - the connective tissue between their data stack, operational systems, and AI agents.

To learn more, visit www.atlan.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

67241e4e9d09abe5.description: Join Arthan Finance in Vasai-Virar as a Machine Learning Engineer Intern. This entry-level internship is designed for students and recent graduates who learn best by building, shipping and getting real feedback on applied machine learning and model deployment work. About the role As a Machine Learning Engineer Intern at Arthan Finance, your core focus will be training, packaging and deploying machine-learning models into production. You are attached to a named mentor, join the team's stand-ups and reviews, and are trusted with work that matters rather than filler tasks. Questions are encouraged, your output is reviewed properly, and you get the feedback you need to actually improve. What you'll do day to day Work on training, packaging and deploying machine-learning models into production alongside the core team Use Python, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Model Deployment (MLOps), Feature Engineering on live, production-facing problems Turn your work into clear documentation, notes or decks for reviewers Take part in reviews and act on the feedback you receive Collaborate across functions engineering, product, design or business as the work demands Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards Track and report your own progress against an agreed plan Skills you'll build You will build practical, demonstrable experience in Python, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Model Deployment (MLOps), Feature Engineering, Pandas & NumPy, Model Evaluation Metrics, Docker, REST / gRPC Model Serving, Experiment Tracking (MLflow) the exact toolkit that separates a hireable fresher from a CV full of coursework. No prior work experience is required. Curiosity, problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn matter far more here than a polished rsum, and every one of these skills is taught on the job. Who should apply Students in their final year or recent graduates from B.E./B.Tech (CSE/IT/ECE), BCA, MCA, M.Sc (CS / Statistics) or M.Tech based in or willing to work from Vasai-Virar. You should be willing to learn Python, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn and able to communicate clearly in writing. Personal projects, coursework, certifications or open-source contributions strengthen your application, but none of them are mandatory. Internship details This is a 3-month internship in Vasai-Virar, Maharashtra, with a stipend of 27,000 per month. You will be given a defined project so that you leave with a model you trained, containerised and put behind a live endpoint. Working hours follow the team's normal business hours and the internship includes a certificate on successful completion. You will finish this internship with practical, demonstrable skills, real project work to point at, and a much clearer sense of how the industry actually operates day to day. Strong performers are considered for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) and a full-time role. How to apply Click Apply Now. If you are not logged in you will be asked to sign in and register first, after which you will be taken to Arthan Finance's official careers page to complete your application. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and seats are limited, so apply early. Responsibilities: Work on training, packaging and deploying machine-learning models into production alongside the core team; Apply Python, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Model Deployment (MLOps) to live, production-facing problems; Document your work clearly for reviewers and stakeholders; Participate in reviews and act on the feedback you receive; Collaborate across engineering, product, design or business as required; Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards. Requirements: Pursuing or recently completed B.E./B.Tech (CSE/IT/ECE), BCA, MCA, M.Sc (CS / Statistics) or M.Tech 2026 freshers & final-year students welcome; Working knowledge of Python, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn (or a genuine willingness to learn them); Strong fundamentals in your discipline and clear problem-solving ability; Care with detail and the discipline to document your work; Clear written and verbal communication in English; Based in or willing to work from Vasai-Virar, Maharashtra. .
